control_semantics.cm_train: mean of QC-pass DMSO rows on the same plate (obs.control_group mixes DMSO+Media and is NOT a matched baseline)
control_semantics.cm_truth_delta: treated log1p_cp10k minus the same-plate QC-pass DMSO log mean, computed only at scoring time
control_semantics.cm_validation_test_inference: one fixed per-fold c* from consensus_controls.npz; never a per-plate control
control_semantics.consensus_provenance: only control rows of plates carrying a TRAINING drug; per-plate log mean then equal plate weight
control_semantics.tahoe_train_validation: mean of the same (plate, cell_line) group's QC-pass control rows on the log layer (tahoe_control_groups.parquet + tahoe_pairs.npz); never across cell lines

fold_semantics.excluded: exclude/uncertain drugs have no fold row and are never test/valid
fold_semantics.plate_confounding: a drug split is not a plate split; a fold's test drugs bring their plates
fold_semantics.population: main_set drugs only; every main-set drug is test in exactly one fold and valid in exactly one fold

gene_axis.measurement_mask: var.gene_measured is PER SOURCE: all True in cm_transfer.h5ad; False only for FAM153B in tahoe_transfer.h5ad.  It is gene-space membership, never a non-zero-count test (18 all-zero Tahoe columns are measured).

routing.control_media: Media is NOT a vehicle control — never merge it into a DMSO pool
routing.positive_control_et1: ET-1 at 0.01 uM is a peptide positive control, not a small-molecule treatment; excluded from the training arm
routing.vehicle_control_dmso: the only vehicle control; source of the consensus pool

routing.no_structure: 2 drugs have no resolvable structure: dropped by the dose encoder, counted as an input-layer exclusion, not a QC failure

locked_config.meaning: the only recipe: model, dose encoding, loss, optimiser, seeds, LR rule, metric, prediction policy, 30-unit policy

purpose: the single frozen two-source 18,164-gene input formal training reads; downstream tickets read these files and never re-derive folds, c* or config

role_selection.expansion_set: cm obs.expansion_set == True (exclude AND qc_pass) is ticket #11's expansion training arm only; never scored, no fold row
role_selection.main_set: cm obs.main_set == True (include AND qc_pass) is the fold/score population
role_selection.tahoe: tahoe obs.tahoe_usable == True is trainable/evaluable; tahoe_split selects train vs valid; time_h never filters
role_selection.uncertain: never trained, never scored, no fold row
